title: Recover the face vectors of three rational Platonic solids

source.citation: Taylor Brysiewicz and Michael Joswig, Polyhedral Geometry in OSCAR, arXiv:2308.07459

translation.notes: The paper's tetrahedron vertices and standard rational cube and cross-polytope vertices are entered independently. Noether certifies their dimensions, face lattices, and the first three displayed Platonic-solid face vectors. The irrational dodecahedron and icosahedron are outside this rational exact-polytope case.
